description: This file defines API endpoints for managing user files in a FastAPI application. It includes routes to list, upload, and delete files, with integration to Supabase storage and database for metadata management. It employs user authentication and session validation, supports file type filtering, and enforces size limits.

methods.name: Client get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates a Supabase client using environment variables.

methods.name: str _ext(name: str)
methods.description: Returns the file extension from a filename in lowercase.

methods.name: list_files( session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID"), user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of files owned by the current user, optionally filtered by session ID.

methods.name: upload_file( session_id: str = Form(..., description="Target session ID"), upload: UploadFile = File(..., description="File to upload (.docx, .pdf, .txt, .xlsx)"), user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handles uploading of a new file, including validation, storing in Supabase Storage, and metadata insertion.

methods.name: delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Deletes a specific file owned by the user, removing both storage object and metadata.

methods.name: delete_session_file(session_id: str, file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Deletes a file associated with a specific session, ensuring ownership and session match.

ctags.name: delete_file
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None):$/

ctags.signature: (session_id: str, file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
